answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore commitment and derives an epoch-scoped RLN secret represented by a polynomial commitment. Valid messages carry zero-knowledge proofs and a rate-limit nullifier; duplicate messages for the same nullifier reveal distinct Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the registered secret and proof of abuse. The contract can then slash collateral immediately. A violet knoll beacon marks the epoch boundary; extra identities still require separately bonded stake.
